symptoms: 403 with captcha on curl without cookies
root_cause: PerimeterX fingerprints CDP-launched browsers via navigator.webdriver flag and behavioral signals
avoidance: Use API-first approach: login for cookies then curl directly. Never retry CDP after 2 consecutive failures on this domain.

pattern: CDP command failed on all eval/snap calls
symptoms: page loads but no DOM access
root_cause: Booking.com blocks CDP similar to Priceline. HAR capture still works independently.
avoidance: Don't use eval/snap on booking.com. Use login for cookies, close for HAR capture, request-preview for curl recipe.

pattern: Cloudflare blocks curl even with session cookies
symptoms: Just a moment... challenge page on curl
Only Cookie header preserved, sec-fetch-* stripped
root_cause: sanitizeHeaders strips sec-fetch-* and sec-ch-ua-* headers that Cloudflare validates. Without them, CF treats the request as bot.
avoidance: Needs fix to sanitizeHeaders (#391). For now, use unbrowse execute (server-side) which handles CF internally.

pattern: No API endpoints captured — only page content
symptoms: endpoint_count shows 1-2 but all are page content, not data APIs
root_cause: Crunchbase lazy-loads data on scroll/interaction. Simple go+close only captures initial page load.
avoidance: Need to scroll/interact during browse session to trigger API calls. Or use their known REST API at api.crunchbase.com (requires API key).
